detailed_description:
The target video is a single continuous shot in a realistic, calm, modern automotive-commercial style with a cool blue color grade and physically smooth, natural light behavior. The camera language is restrained: an 85mm medium-telephoto lens in medium composition, a stabilized rear tracking shot from directly behind the car, eye level with a slight upward tilt, no visible damping or easing. The shot begins from the result state of the previous shot — a glossy highlight has just slid along the body toward the tail — continuing without reset or re-entry.
[Shot 1] The frame opens with <Subject 1>, the steel-blue NIO ET7 with its full-width red taillight bar, black panoramic roof, roof-front lidar pod, and "NIO et7" rear badge, already nearing the tunnel exit, centered slightly forward in frame with its rear fascia and rear windshield steady and razor-sharp. From 0 to 2 seconds, <Subject 2>, the tunnel environment of <Picture 1>, still wraps the body: raw concrete walls, linear white LED strips along the ceiling, wet reflective asphalt with lane markings, all in cool residual blue tones; the tunnel echo rings briefly. The camera tracks at matched speed with the car in a smooth, restrained push alongside, holding the same medium framing. From 2 to 4 seconds, the car crosses the threshold and exits the tunnel; cool blue daylight rapidly floods the frame, the exit's blue glow diffusing visibly in the air as overall brightness rises. Under the blue skylight, the taillight bar's brightness is relatively subdued against the daylight, the body's highlight rhythm settles into a smoother, restrained afterglow, and the last glossy highlight slides off the roof's rear. The tunnel echo fades quickly, giving way to open-road wind and a looser, more diffuse tire rolling sound that transitions in sync with the visual exit. From 4 to 5 seconds, linear light strips along the eaves of distant modern buildings begin to emerge faintly against the hazy sky, establishing the real-world scene for the next shot; the frame settles on one clean, cool bright edge along the roof's rear plus the faint distant building light strips as the visual cut-out point, with the rear of the car still stable and centered. No dialogue, no subtitles, no on-screen text appears anywhere in the frame.
